items.snippet: Turrón by Plazo, the card-based buy now, pay later (BNPL) solution developed by Barcelona-founded fintech ID Finance as part of its financial app Plazo , has signed a strategic partnership with Wonderbox in Spain, a leading provider of experience gifts.

items.title: NBX partners Visa for stablecoin-linked card
items.snippet: Visa, a world leader in digital payments, NBX, Tieto and IDT Finance today announced plans for a new Visa Flex Card that will give eligible NBX customers a simpler way to use the different forms of money they hold.

items.title: CredAble acquires 70% stake in Reql
items.snippet: CredAble, India’s leading working capital and banking technology platform, today announced that it has acquired a 70% stake in Reql, an AI-native regulatory intelligence platform. With Reql, CredAble expands its banking technology portfolio into Reg-Tech, bringing a dedicated AI platform to compliance and legal teams at banks, financial institutions and corporates.

items.title: BTS and Veridas partner to strengthen digital identity and fraud prevention
items.snippet: BTS, a global telecommunications and technology company, and Veridas, a leader in digital identity verification and biometric authentication, have announced a global partnership to expand identity verification, authentication and fraud prevention capabilities across Europe, Latin America and North America.
